title: c52 digestion ecology at half taxis (chiF 0.25): does the predator then need its own digestion product (kd=0 arms), and does the ecology still divide?
summary: Screen on seed 61: at chiF 0.3 and 0.2, kd=0 everywhere kills 3 of 3 target predators within 400-600 t while their prey stay at fed size, unlike chiF 0.5 (20261027T1900-c60-kd0-arms). Plan: kd=0 per-target arms at chiF 0.25 on seeds 61, 62, then labkit 256^2 packs with the predator-free twin and E controls.
